# Custom modules

Accounts with an [Enterprise support plan](/support/plans) can deploy Momento Cache
Capacity Pools with custom modules. Custom-module deployments are available for production use.

## Arrange deployment

Contact your account support representative to coordinate deployment. Confirm the module set
and commands available for your Capacity Pool with your representative before deployment.

## Recommended modules

| Module | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| [JSON](/product/cache/custom-modules/json) | Store JSON documents, query nested values with JSONPath, and update individual fields. |
| [Search](/product/cache/custom-modules/search) | Index and query Hash or JSON data with full-text, tag, numeric, and vector search. |
| [Bloom](/product/cache/custom-modules/bloom) | Check probable membership and screen duplicate candidates with compact filters that can return false positives. |

For embeddings and semantic retrieval, use the
[Search module's vector features](/product/cache/custom-modules/search#vector-search).

The module pages summarize features and key commands. Follow their links to the original Valkey
references for complete syntax and examples.
